more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the EU.
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Polyglycerol esters of fatty acids is used as an emulsifier in food. Its technological role is to help oil and water remain mixed.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include meal replacement for weight control as referred to in Commission Regulation (EU) no 432/2012, flavoured fermented milk products including heat-treated products, dairy analogues, including beverage whiteners, other confectionery including breath freshening micro-sweets. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.origin: Made by esterifying polyglycerol with edible fats, oils or their fatty acids. The polyglycerol component mainly contains short chains of glycerol units.
more_info.dietary_restrictions: The fatty-acid feedstock is not specified as exclusively plant derived. Vegan, vegetarian, halal and kosher suitability cannot be established without the supplier identifying the raw material and processing.
more_info.side_effects:
EFSA found no concern for assessed food uses.
A limited three-week human study reported no adverse findings at larger intakes.
